claim: A parameterized physics-informed neural network that learns a latent space can reduce the average L2 absolute and relative errors by approximately 100× compared to non-parameterized baselines on parameterized PDEs.
falsifier: Train a parameterized physics-informed neural network with a latent space and a non-parameterized baseline on the same parameterized PDEs, then compare L2 absolute and relative errors.

conditions: the evaluation is on benchmark 1D and 2D parameterized PDEs
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported benchmark PDEs and the specific P2INN architecture; the magnitude of reduction may vary for other PDE families.

title: Using a parameterized architecture–reduction in L2 absolute principle
